limits: Offline selected Nuked plus SegaPSG, no device or cross-platform compiler. Native legacy fixed clocks 7,670,454 / 3,579,545 Hz; runtime clock switching is not added. Stop retains the existing Native authored-patch replay policy and suppresses emitted PCM until a voice trigger; natural reset matches Browser raw idle. Status, IRQ and all four read ports are compared after every output frame. Callback C++ new/delete and Nuked C malloc/free are counted; the alternate ymfm API links to fail-fast stubs to prove no hidden ymfm calls. The combined gain transport preserves independent ramps for FM/PSG targets that did not change; overlapping source edits are compared.
selfTest: Native Nuked self-test passed: raw reset DC, exact Stop silence, FM/CSM/DAC/PSG retrigger, finite PCM and no alternate ymfm calls and zero C/C++ callback allocations/deallocations
